# BRIEF - kh_short60 / film_a: "A reward in this world is the wonder" (pilot vertical short, 43.7 s, 1080x1920)

Supervisor: strong model. Builder: Sonnet. Output: ONE page `productions/kh_short60/film_a.html`, portrait 9:16.
Audience: Jewish adults and teens watching a vertical short on a phone; the voice (a rabbi giving a lesson) is mixed LOCALLY later - the render has NO audio and NO captions from the voice.
Idea of the lesson (one sentence): the Torah spoke of a reward in THIS world as a wonder - that the physical world runs on spiritual laws (good deeds -> rain -> fruit).
ONE central metaphor: golden threads that tie a good deed on the ground to the sky; the sky answers with rain; the field turns green.

- `film({W: 1080, H: 1920, shots:[...], vault:'captions_vault.json'})`, NO title card, NO recap card (total = sum of shots = 43.70 s exactly; check `window.__dur`).
- Shot durations and caption times are LOCKED in `timeline.json` (`capAt` = local seconds from the real voice). Use `capAt` as given, do not recompute. Captions only via IDs `CAP_A_01..07` (zero Hebrew in code).

Hero (the man) height >= 40% of frame height in the key moment of each shot. Keep key objects inside x = 8%..92%.
- Camera is vertical-friendly: tilt up/down (crane, pushIn, dolly along the thread). Every shot moves; frame 0 is never empty; hook (man + book + glowing doorway on the hill) visible inside 3 s.
- Last 2 s of the film: calm, nothing entering the frame (an outro card follows later, made elsewhere).

## Shots (captions: IDs only; full text is in `captions_vault.json`, never print it)
Global timeline: s01 0-8.7 | s02 8.7-19.2 | s03 19.2-29.5 | s04 29.5-43.7.

### s01 (8.7 s) caps: CAP_A_01 (at 0.0) - "the question"
- World: dry golden field, low sun, a wooden table with an open book (bookOpen) at the left-middle; far up on a hill at the right a glowing golden doorway (the world to come). Dry field, 2 bare trees.
- MAN stands behind the table. 0-3 s gesture `think` (the book in front of him, a bobbing gold "?" floats up from it, 0.8 m tall, rises 1.5 m between 1.5 s and 4 s). 3-5.5 s `point` toward the doorway then `shrug` at 5.5 s (the book has no door). 6-8.7 s `explain` (the answer is simple).
- Camera: low three-quarter angle, start wide (man 25% of frame height, doorway visible), pushIn to man 45% by 8.7 s with a slight tilt-up to include the "?" and the doorway.
- Must be visible by 3 s: man, book, "?", doorway. Rest: 0.8 s hold on the shrug.

### s02 (10.5 s) caps: CAP_A_02 (at 0.0), CAP_A_03 (at 5.5) - "the Torah speaks about doing, here"
- Same valley, camera angle changes (seam: exit direction of s01 = pushIn forward and up; s02 enters from above and swings down, same speed).
- 0-5.5 s: the doorway glows on the hill, the MAN looks up (`up` gesture) - prophets arouse us toward the purpose. Slow crane from high to eye level.
- 5.5-10.5 s: the earth, doing: the MAN walks down a stone path (follow) to a poor man sitting by a fence and gives him a loaf (`offer`), the poor man stands and gives `thumb`; behind them a farmer plants/waters a young tree (`explain` gesture loop). Camera tracks sideways, all three men in frame at 8 s.
- Hero rule: one hero at a time - the MAN stays the hero; the others are smaller and behind.

### s03 (10.3 s) caps: CAP_A_04 (at 0.0), CAP_A_05 (at 5.8) - "reward in this world is the wonder: rain in its time"
- Local time 0-2 s: MAN with `heart` gesture, a thin golden thread grows from his chest up through the frame (travelling dash), reaching a small white cloud high above at 4 s (camera tilts up along the thread, ease io).
- 4-6 s: the cloud swells and darkens (scale and colour driven by t, 0xffffff -> 0x8a93a6), thread glows.
- 5.8-10.3 s: rain begins (rain() 800 drops) over the whole field; the field colour lerps dry -> green, trees/bushes colour lerps to living green, small flowers pop (scale tween) on the ground. Camera tilts back down following the rain, ends on the MAN with `wide` gesture (open palms), face up, 1.5 s rest.
- Must be visible by 3 s: thread + cloud + man.

### s04 (14.2 s) caps: CAP_A_06 (at 0.0), CAP_A_07 (at 6.7) - "a physical world run by spiritual laws"
- 0-6.7 s: slow big crane up and back: the whole valley green, 3 houses, the farmer and the poor man small in the field; from each man and each house a golden thread rises to the same luminous cloud / sun (sunDisc); the threads pulse in sequence (pulse(t) with 0.4 s stagger). Rain is lighter now. The MAN stays recognisable at the bottom (>= 12% height).
- 6.7-14.2 s: the question beat: a golden coin lifts from the doorway on the hill (arc path, tween), floats down along the thread into the MAN's open hand (`offer`), he looks at it (`think`) then looks up and spreads his arms (`wide`) at 11 s. Last 3 s: the camera drifts slowly closer, warm sun rays, birds flock crossing the sky, nothing new enters; final frame = MAN in the green field under a golden sky.
- Rest: key moment (coin in hand) holds >= 1 s.
